description: Add auto-send-to-email functionality: extend the generate-health-report Edge Function (or create a send-health-report-email function) that sends the generated report to the user's email address automatically. This includes building an HTML email template with the report summary and triggering delivery via Supabase (or a simple SMTP/Resend integration).
steps: Create supabase/functions/send-health-report-email/index.ts - a new Edge Function that: (a) accepts { type: 'weekly' | 'monthly' } and optionally { email: string }, (b) calls the generate-health-report logic internally (or re-aggregates the data), (c) formats the report data into an HTML email template, (d) sends the email using Resend API (RESEND_API_KEY env var) since Supabase does not have built-in transactional email for custom content

Build an HTML email template function that renders: header with REPGATE branding, date range, top stats, nutrition summary table, push-up log table, progress summary, AI insight, and footer disclaimer. Style inline for email compatibility.
The function should look up the user's email from Supabase Auth (auth.admin.getUserById) if no email is provided in the request body

Add a trigger mechanism: either (a) a cron-like approach where daily-pushup-check or a new scheduled function calls this on Sunday/month-end, or (b) the Flutter client calls this after displaying the report. Prefer option (b) for now - add a 'Send to Email' button in the Flutter report screen that invokes this function.
In the Flutter report screen (lib/screens/reports/reports_screen.dart), add a 'Send to Email' action button (envelope icon or text button) that calls the send-health-report-email Edge Function
Create lib/services/report_service.dart method sendReportToEmail(type) that invokes the send-health-report-email function
acceptance_criteria: Function generates an HTML email with report data
Function sends email via Resend API (or similar service)
Flutter report screen has a 'Send to Email' button
verification: Read the Edge Function and verify it follows the common.ts invoke pattern
Verify the HTML email template includes all major report sections
Verify the Flutter screen includes the email button
